requirements.title: The listed events make pointer association status undefined
requirements.definition: Pointer association status becomes undefined for the listed pointer-assignment, target-lifetime, allocation-transfer, subprogram-completion, BLOCK-completion, DO CONCURRENT, allocation, INTENT(OUT), and unevaluated-function-reference events.

requirements.oracle: Undefined pointer association status has no portable positive runtime oracle. This catalogue records the source events and requires future fixtures to avoid ASSOCIATED, dereference, invocation, comparison, or definition-status observations until a defined status is reestablished.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Unnumbered program restrictions are source-control restrictions only. Notes are informative. Coarray, image, team, companion-processor lifetime, volatile-interference, addresses, diagnostic wording, exit status details, and processor-dependent representations are not asserted.
